blocks.text: Distribution center operations supervisor with 10 years at Tumbleweed Home Goods, now running a second shift of 35 associates on Manhattan WMS. Opened the company's new Fernley, NV cross-dock in 2022 and brought the building up to speed, raising on-time shipping from 79% to 98% in five months. Came up through receiving, putaway, picking and packing as an associate and a warehouse lead.
Opened the new Fernley, NV cross-dock in March 2022 and ramped it up: built the shift schedule, trained the first 18 associates and raised on-time shipping from 79% to 98% by August 2022.
Supervise a second shift of 35 associates in a 400,000-square-foot distribution center.
Held inventory accuracy at 99.6% through 2023 and 2024 with weekly cycle counts.
Cut mis-picks from 1.2% to 0.4% with a second scan at pack-out in the Manhattan warehouse management system.
Led a receiving team of 12 and set its daily putaway plan.
Trained 40 new associates on Manhattan WMS scanners and putaway rules.
Picked, packed and received freight, and moved up to lead after two years.
Forklift Certification, Sit-Down and Reach Truck | 2017
Manhattan WMS, WMS scanners, sit-down and reach truck forklifts, cycle counts, shift scheduling, associate training, receiving, putaway, picking and packing
